faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: 130+ carrier appointments across Life, Health and Supplementary — national and regional. The list grows as we add appointments.
faq.q2: Do you own my book of business?
faq.a2: No. You keep 100% ownership of your book from day one. Epicare is your operating infrastructure, not the owner of your work.
faq.q3: How much does the platform cost?
faq.a3: GO AMS, GO CRM, Eppigo and Academy are included in your producer contract, with no platform fee. The only thing agreed at contracting is your commission split.
faq.q4: Do I need to be in Florida?
faq.a4: No. We are headquartered in Miami, but we operate across all 52 jurisdictions: the 50 states, Washington DC and Puerto Rico. You sell wherever you are licensed.
faq.q5: Is Epicare a startup or an established company?
faq.a5: Epicare Insurance Corp has been operating since 2021, with 6,000+ insured members and 100+ active agents. EIN 87-1093490 · NPN 19985316 · EPICARE® registered with the USPTO (Reg. 8148738).
faq.q6: What if I already have my own CRM?
faq.a6: Keep using it. GO AMS is where your contracts, commissions and licensing live — that does not get duplicated in another system. Your data is exportable whenever you need it.
faq.q7: How long does full onboarding take?
faq.a7: 24 to 48 hours from signing if your licenses are active. Carrier appointments depend on each carrier turnaround; you track the live status from the portal.
